After.description: What a hold's `after` waits for: another task to end, or a Linear issue to close.

BatchRequest.description: The issues a batch's planning task plans, as task keys, and the workflow of its entries' tasks.

entries.description: The workflow each entry's task runs.

Confidence.description:
How sure an agent is that its recommendation is what the person would pick, and the lowest
such confidence a task's `auto_answer` lets the daemon act on.

FromTo.description: A value before and after a `pre` script.

FromTo2.description: A value before and after a `pre` script.

FromTo3.description: A value before and after a `pre` script.

Hold.description:
Why a task is held, and the conditions that release it once all of them hold. With none, a
person does.

after.description:
Other tasks' ids, or Linear issues such as `ENG-7`: until each task ends and each issue is
Done or Canceled. One value or a list.

blockers.description: Until the task's Linear issue has no open blocker.

if_closed.description: What a pull request closed without a merge does: `release`, `drop` or `ask`, the default.

merge.description:
Pull requests, `owner/name#42` or `42` in the task's repository: until each merges. One
value or a list.

parked.description:
Parks a task keyed by a pull request: a comment or review trigger's request for that pull
request releases it, and the pull request's merge or close ends it.

reason.description: Why the task waits, shown to a person.

until.description: An RFC 3339 instant, or a duration such as `2 hours` after the hold.

Intervention.description: Who answers a task's asks. Unset, every ask goes to a person.

oneOf.description:
A person approves the plan: a grading step's result waits for an answer before the task
moves on, even for a green grade.

The trigger's `lead` answers asks in the person's place, except an ask whose answer lets an
irreversible step run and an ask whose answer runs a command.

IssueOrder.description: Where a Linear issue stands in its project, as the intake saw it.

milestone.description: The issue's milestone; null without one.

sort_order.description: The issue's manual order in Linear. Lower comes first.

MilestoneOrder.description: Where a milestone stands in its project.

sort_order.description: The milestone's manual order in its project. Lower comes first.

target_date.description: The milestone's target date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null without one.

OneOrMany_After.description: One value, or a list of them; null reads as none, as the single values it replaced did.

OneOrMany_string.description: One value, or a list of them; null reads as none, as the single values it replaced did.

PreRan.description: What a trigger's `pre` script did to a request: its name alone when it changed nothing.

context.description: The context's length in characters before and after; null for none.

failed.description: How it failed, such as `exit 2: <stderr tail>`. The request is the one the trigger built.

seconds.description: How long it ran. With `changed` or `failed` only.

text.description: The request text's length in characters before and after; null for none.

title.description: The title's length in characters before and after; null for none.

Relation.description: A relation a request asks its new task to have: `--relates KIND:TASK`.

TaskRequested.description: A request for a task. Only this message creates a task.

band.description: The trigger's or the request's band.

batch.description: The batch a planning task plans, from `priory batch add`.

context.description: Text the trigger's `pre` script adds after the request.

hold.description: Files the task held: the trigger's `hold`, or `priory request --hold`.

intervention.description:
Who answers the task's asks, from `priory request` or `priory add --intervention`; the
trigger's when unset.

key.description: Which events are the same work, such as `github:owner/name#42` or `linear:ENG-7`.

lane.description: The trigger's or the request's lane; null when `lanes.toml` derives it.

order.description:
Where the Linear issue stands in its project, which orders the task in the queue; null
without a project. Linear view and project sources only.

pre.description: What the trigger's `pre` script did. Triggers with one only.

project.description: The Linear issue's project name, or null without one. Linear sources only.

prompt.description: The trigger's `prompt`, or null without one. Schedule sources only.

relates.description:
How the new task relates to existing ones, from `priory request --relates`. The daemon skips
a relation to a task that does not exist.

repo.description:
The repository the task works in: `priory request --repo` for a CLI request, the pull
request's for a review request. Those sources only. A task whose `repo` is not a GitHub
`owner/name` blocks before its first run.

scheduled.description: When the firing was due. Schedule sources only.

session.description:
The outside session that added the task through `priory mcp --outside`: its hc terminal,
then its Claude session id, or `outside` without an hc terminal. CLI sources only.

source.description: The `id` of the source event's message.

team.description: The Linear issue's team key. Linear sources only.

text.description: The task's request text, in place of the source event's, from the trigger's `pre` script.

title.description: The task's title, in place of the source event's, from the trigger's `pre` script.

description: A request for a task. Only this message creates a task.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: factory.task.requested
